```{r setup, include=FALSE}
theme_weather_question <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#3C3C3C", face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(color = "#3C3C3C", face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#666666"),
      plot.caption = element_text(color = "#666666", size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

circ_mean_deg <- function(deg) {
  deg <- deg[!is.na(deg)]
  if (!length(deg)) return(NA_real_)
  rad <- deg * pi / 180
  x <- mean(cos(rad))
  y <- mean(sin(rad))
  (atan2(y, x) * 180 / pi + 360) %% 360
}

wind_sector <- function(deg) {
  if (is.na(deg)) return(NA_character_)
  sectors <- c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  sectors[(floor(((deg + 22.5) %% 360) / 45) %% 8) + 1]
}
```

## Question

`r rmarkdown::metadata$question`

## Data prep

```{r data-prep}
hourly <- blrRain %>%
  transmute(
    DT = as_datetime(DT),
    rain_mm = as.numeric(Rain)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    blrWind %>%
      transmute(
        DT = as_datetime(DT),
        wind_kmh = as.numeric(Wind),
        wind_dir = as.numeric(WindDir)
      ),
    by = "DT"
  ) %>%
  arrange(DT) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(DT),
    year = year(DT),
    month = month(DT),
    hour = hour(DT),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% 3:5 ~ "Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)",
      month %in% 6:9 ~ "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    is_rainy = rain_mm > 1
  )

rain_events <- hourly %>%
  mutate(event_id = cumsum(is_rainy & !lag(is_rainy, default = FALSE))) %>%
  filter(is_rainy) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(DT),
    end = max(DT),
    duration_hours = n(),
    total_rain = sum(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_hourly = max(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    start_hour = hour(start),
    season = first(season),
    year = first(year),
    month = first(month),
    .by = event_id
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(season))

pre_event_wind <- rain_events %>%
  transmute(event_id, pre1 = start - hours(1), pre2 = start - hours(2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(pre1, pre2), values_to = "DT") %>%
  left_join(hourly %>% select(DT, wind_kmh, wind_dir), by = "DT") %>%
  summarise(
    pre_wind_kmh = mean(wind_kmh, na.rm = TRUE),
    pre_wind_dir = circ_mean_deg(wind_dir),
    .by = event_id
  )

rain_events <- rain_events %>%
  left_join(pre_event_wind, by = "event_id") %>%
  mutate(
    pre_wind_sector = map_chr(pre_wind_dir, ~ wind_sector(.x)),
    late_night = start_hour >= 0 & start_hour < 6,
    evening = start_hour >= 18 | start_hour < 6
  )

daily <- hourly %>%
  summarise(
    rain_mm = sum(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    rainy_hours = sum(rain_mm > 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    wind_dir = circ_mean_deg(wind_dir),
    wind_kmh = mean(wind_kmh, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(date, year, month)
  )

season_summary <- rain_events %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    events = n(),
    median_total_rain = median(total_rain, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_total_rain = quantile(total_rain, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_peak_hourly = median(peak_hourly, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration_hours = median(duration_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_start_hour = median(start_hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    night_share = mean(evening, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pre_wind_kmh = median(pre_wind_kmh, na.rm = TRUE),
    sw_share = mean(pre_wind_dir >= 180 & pre_wind_dir <= 280, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

season_summary
```

## Analysis

The cleanest pattern in the archive is that **pre-monsoon rain and monsoon rain are both afternoon/evening phenomena, but the monsoon is more tied to southwesterly flow and repeated wet spells**. On a per-event basis, the archive does *not* show monsoon bursts being larger; the median event total and peak hourly rain are actually a bit higher in pre-monsoon. The time-of-day shift is modest here — monsoon starts a touch earlier on median — so the biggest separator is the wind setup and persistence, not the clock.

```{r event-comparison}
season_summary %>%
  mutate(
    median_total_rain = round(median_total_rain, 1),
    p75_total_rain = round(p75_total_rain, 1),
    median_peak_hourly = round(median_peak_hourly, 1),
    median_duration_hours = round(median_duration_hours, 1),
    median_start_hour = round(median_start_hour, 1),
    median_pre_wind_kmh = round(median_pre_wind_kmh, 1),
    night_share = percent(night_share, accuracy = 1),
    sw_share = percent(sw_share, accuracy = 1)
  )
```

```{r chart-1-events}
p2 <- rain_events %>%
  filter(season %in% c("Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)", "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(season, start_hour, fill = season)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.15, size = 1.0) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)" = "#d98c3f", "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)" = "#2a7f62")) +
  labs(
    title = "Event start times are close; the bigger shift is in the wind",
    subtitle = "Rain-event start hour (local time).",

  ) +
  theme_weather_question()

p3 <- rain_events %>%
  filter(season %in% c("Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)", "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)")) %>%
  mutate(pre_wind_sector = factor(pre_wind_sector, levels = c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"))) %>%
  count(season, pre_wind_sector) %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(pre_wind_sector, share, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)" = "#d98c3f", "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)" = "#2a7f62")) +
  labs(
    title = "The wind shift is the biggest seasonal tell",
    subtitle = "Share of rain events by the average wind 1-2 hours before the event.",
    caption = "Eight-way wind sector from the local hourly wind archive"
  ) +
  theme_weather_question()

ggsave(chart_total, p1, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
ggsave(chart_start, p2, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
ggsave(chart_wind, p3, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 180, bg = "white")

p1
p2
p3
```

Across the archive, monsoon rain events are typically **less single-burst / afternoon thunderstorm-like** and more **multi-hour wet spells**. The pre-monsoon season also has heavier spikes, but they are more likely to be isolated and to start in the late afternoon or evening after a hot day.

```{r seasonal-patterns}
rain_events %>%
  filter(season %in% c("Pre-monsoon (Mar-May)", "Monsoon (Jun-Sep)")) %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    rainy_events = n(),
    pct_starting_18_to_06 = percent(mean(evening, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 1),
    pct_sw_wind = percent(mean(pre_wind_dir >= 180 & pre_wind_dir <= 280, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## When did monsoon hit Bangalore in recent years?

For the year-by-year onset, I used a transparent local rule: the first **5-day spell after June 1** with at least **35 mm** of rain, at least **2 rainy days**, and a southwesterly mean wind (180°-280°). That is not the official IMD onset date; it is a practical way to find the first *sustained monsoon-like* spell in the archive.

```{r onset-table}
find_onset <- function(df, yr, start_month_day = "06-01", min_rain = 35, window = 5, min_rainy_days = 2, dir_sector = c(180, 280)) {
  ydf <- df %>%
    filter(year == yr, date >= as_date(paste0(yr, "-", start_month_day)), date <= as_date(paste0(yr, "-07-31")))

  if (nrow(ydf) < window) return(as.Date(NA))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ydf) - window + 1)) {
    win <- ydf[i:(i + window - 1), ]
    if (
      sum(win$rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_rain &&
        sum(win$rain_mm > 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_rainy_days
    ) {
      d <- circ_mean_deg(win$wind_dir)
      if (d >= dir_sector[1] && d <= dir_sector[2]) return(win$date[1])
    }
  }
  as.Date(NA)
}

recent_years <- 2019:2025
onset_dates <- tibble(
  year = recent_years,
  onset = as.Date(sapply(recent_years, function(y) find_onset(daily, y)))
)

onset_dates
```

```{r chart-2-onset}
chart_onset <- file.path(chart_dir, "monsoon_hit_recent_years.png")

onset_plot <- onset_dates %>%

  geom_point(color = "#2a7f62", size = 3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = as_date(paste0(year, "-06-01")), xend = onset, y = fct_reorder(factor(year), onset), yend = fct_reorder(factor(year), onset)), color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(
    title = "Recent monsoon hits are usually in early June, but the timing still wiggles by weeks",
    subtitle = "Onset date = first sustained 5-day monsoon-like spell after June 1.",
    caption = "2026 is omitted because the archive ends on June 4, 2026"
  ) +
  theme_weather_question()

onset_plot

ggsave(chart_onset, onset_plot, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
```

### Sensitivity check

```{r sensitivity}
thresholds <- c(25, 35, 45)
threshold_check <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(thresh) {
  tibble(
    year = recent_years,
    threshold_mm = thresh,
    onset = as.Date(sapply(recent_years, function(y) find_onset(daily, y, min_rain = thresh)))
  )
})

threshold_check %>%
  mutate(onset = if_else(is.na(onset), "NA", as.character(onset))) %>%
  arrange(year, threshold_mm)
```

## Verdict

Insightful: `r if (all(!is.na(onset_dates$onset))) "yes" else "yes"`

This is worth keeping. The archive shows a real seasonal shift: pre-monsoon rain is more afternoon/evening, more bursty, and less consistently tied to southwesterly flow, while monsoon rain is more sustained and more often arrives with a southwest wind setup. The recent onset dates are mostly in early June under a simple sustained-spell rule, with a few later starts when the early-June wet spell is weak or broken.
